name: Foundry Indexes
summary: project.indexes.create_or_update registers an Azure AI Search index as a project-level resource, queried from a BYOM-routed agent via AzureAISearchTool.
description: Verified live 2026-07-15 against ai-gateway-pe-testing (APIM-only, no account-local model deployments; Basic-SKU AI Search): `project.indexes.create_or_update(AzureAISearchIndex(connection_name=..., index_name=...))` registers the index and a BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent with `AzureAISearchTool` can query it end-to-end. This is the primitive shown under the portal's 'Indexes' tab — NOT the higher-level Foundry IQ 'Knowledge bases' surface (see `knowledge-bases` card, which needs Standard-SKU + semantic ranker + network access).
notes: Works with Basic-tier AI Search; semantic ranker is not required at this layer. Query paths: 'simple', 'semantic', 'vector', 'vector_simple_hybrid', 'vector_semantic_hybrid' (the latter three require an index with the corresponding capabilities enabled).
